info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Public Reference Data Management API
info.description: The Public Reference Data Management API facilitates the management and distribution of market data used within banking operations. This API allows users to submit and update critical reference data, ensuring accuracy and consistency across various banking systems. Typical consumers include financial analysts, data engineers, and software applications requiring up-to-date reference datasets. By streamlining data management, the API enhances decision-making processes and operational efficiency in market data handling.

post.description: This endpoint allows clients to submit new public reference data to the market data management system. Properly formatted data must be provided to ensure successful processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to manage public reference data within the market data service. Provide the necessary details in JSON format to perform the desired operations.
